summary: Frontend-only test of public legal pages, Landing Legal & Policies section, logged-in legal footer, and Landing CMS publish sync. Found a CRITICAL bug: logged-out /legal/* pages bounced to /login, so the feature was broken as delivered. Fixed it (Layout NotifBell 401 -> interceptor redirect). Also fixed a landing footer contrast bug. After the fixes, all 4 requested features pass. Publish sync was checked end-to-end: an admin-published marker showed up in a clean context, then it was reverted to the original subtitle.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. While logged out, Layout polled GET external /api/notifications/me -> 401. The api.js interceptor then hard-redirected to /login, so every /legal/* page bounced to login. Fix: skip load() when getToken() is empty.

FIXED BY TESTER. The footer's dark background divs use -z-10 inside a footer with no stacking context, so they painted behind the page bg. Result: white text on a near-white background (almost invisible). Fix: added the 'isolate' class to the footer.

issues: Shows the full logged-in app shell: sidebar (Dashboard, Wallet, KYC...), avatar 'U', cart/bell and a 'Log out' button. Clicking any of these bounces to /login. Use a public/minimal header (logo, Sign in, Back to home) when there is no user.

The Publish success/warn message (admin-landing-msg) renders at the top of a long page (measured y=-3402px when Publish is clicked from the sticky bottom bar), so the admin never sees it. Use a toast or show it next to the Publish button.
The warn text for a failed publish still mentions the obsolete network-pay-1 SettingsUpdate/landing_cms instructions. Update it.

action_items: Review and keep tester fix in components/Layout.jsx (NotifBell skips /notifications/me without a token). Also check other public pages that wrap Layout for authenticated GETs.
Render a public header in Layout when !user (no sidebar, Log out or avatar) for /legal/*
Make the AdminLanding publish result visible (toast or near the button) and update the obsolete warn text
Note: loadCms merges localStorage over the remote value, so an admin's stale local preview can mask published content in the admin's own browser
critical_code_review_comments: lib/api.js interceptor hard-redirects to /login on any 401 GET, even on public pages. This is fragile; consider skipping the redirect on public routes (/, /legal/*).

landingCms.loadCms: the precedence {...remote, ...local} lets the local preview override published content. publishCms sets _cache without the local copy, which is fine, but the precedence is confusing after a reload.
Landing.jsx is 1007 lines. Split it into section components.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after tester fixes (legal public access was 0/5 before the fix)

seed_data_creation: No seed data. The hero_subtitle was temporarily published with the marker QA-SYNC-1793167615 and then restored to the original text via Publish.

Landing: section-legal, legal-card-*, nav a[href='#legal']. Layout footer: app-legal-{terms,privacy,refund,contact,about}. Admin CMS: /admin/landing, cms-hero_subtitle, cms-publish, admin-landing-msg. Publish -> PUT /api/landing-cms on the local backend; public GET /api/landing-cms.
rca of the issue: Legal bounce: Legal.jsx renders inside Layout, and Layout mounts NotifBell, which calls the authenticated external GET /notifications/me. When logged out this returns 401. The api.js response interceptor (GET, not /admin/) calls clearTokens and sets window.location.href='/login'. Reproduced on all 5 kinds. After the token guard there are 0 401s and all pages render content (305-882 chars).
